elements.name: Table 7
elements.text:
Importance
Context Data
Question this answers Instructions
Must Have
Typical name
The name by which we would colloquially describe the slide / content

Target Audience
Who are the senior most stakeholder that would see this slide?

Target Forum
What is the typical forum this slide would be used at?

Slide Purpose
What is the communication intent (inform, persuade, compare, etc.)?

Key Takeaway
What is the one sentence the audience should take away from this slide?

Content Type
What is the structural nature of the content (data, comparison, timeline, framework, org. chart etc.)?
Nice to Have
Usage
How will it be used?

Position in Narrative
Where did this fall in the narrative arc (Context, call-to-action, Hypothesis / Answer First / Framework, Evidence etc.)? 

Information Density
What is the detail for an audience to grasp (single big message  vs Data/Reference Slide)?

elements.name: TextBox 11
elements.text: INSTRUCTIONS: We are collecting additional examples of client ready slides to try and train a purpose-built AI model on how to build strategy grade presentations/slides. In order for the model to really learn how we build slides and to ensure it understands the context we want to enrich each slide with context to help the AI not just understand what to say but how to say it. Please, add the below context to the speaker notes for each slide you add. See Slide 6 for an example
